name: Fab DRC Rules
description: Install the design rules (DRC) of your PCB fab: JLCPCB, PCBWay, OSH Park, Eurocircuits, AISLER and more
description_full:
A PCB-editor toolbar button that installs the design rules of the PCB fab you are sending the board to.

Pick the fab and a profile (layer count, copper weight, standard or extra-cost options). The plugin writes the fab's custom rules into the project's .kicad_dru, inside a marked block that keeps your own rules, and can set Board Setup > Constraints minimums.

Copper clearance goes into Board Setup rather than a custom rule, so net-class clearances keep working.

Included fabs: AISLER, ALLPCB, Elecrow, Eurocircuits, JLCPCB, NextPCB, OSH Park, PCBCart, PCBWay, Seeed Fusion. Every value comes with its source URL and the date it was read; check the fab's page before ordering.
